The text clearly presents a single-number final estimate for the total number of black spots on all living giraffes.

The calculation is:
- Total Population: 116,000 giraffes
- Average Spots per Giraffe: 900
- Total Spots = 116,000 × 900 = 104,400,000

This number is stated at the beginning of the text and confirmed multiple times throughout the reasoning section.
